anchor.semantic_hook: Detriment is staged as every gain placed on one side of a balance causing visible damage to the person or thing on the opposite side.
anchor.setting: An empty appraisal hall contains a two-pan balance, a central evidence table, and bays for interchangeable objects. Whenever weight reaches the benefit pan, the other pan develops an impossibly deep crater while the floor beneath it remains intact.
anchor.absurd_element: an impossibly deep crater forming inside only the detriment pan

variations.scene_adjust: a miniature home football goal, a match ball, a victory medal, and a league-leader cup on the opposing pan
